title: Risk Signal Orchestrator and Milestone Playbook for Compliance Cutovers
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: create a deterministic playbook and lightweight orchestration layer we can use to gate and automate compliance cutovers (SOC2/ISO, SSO/SAML, audit log retention) across Dedicated and Private deployments. This ticket captures the product-level milestone definitions, owner matrix, risk signals, gating checks, and escalation paths so engineering and security can implement the automation and dashboards.

Why this is different: existing milestone trackers capture dates and evidence; this playbook adds a structured 'risk signal' model (binary and graded signals), automated pre-cutover checks, and explicit rollback criteria so we can reduce manual gating while preserving auditability. The deliverable is a single-page milestone schema plus a runbook template and a set of dashboards/alerts mapping to each signal.

Scope:
- Milestone schemas for three compliance cutover types: SOC2 evidence-collection cutover, SSO/SAML identity provider migration, audit-log retention policy switch.
- Define 12 canonical risk signals (e.g., test user auth failures, deployment velocity delta, agent telemetry gaps, evidence ingestion lag, schema mismatch counts, automated test pass rate).
- Owner mapping and decision matrix for each milestone gate (primary, secondary, approver).
- Integrations required: Console telemetry, runtime health metrics, onboarding workflows, Customer Success checklist.
- Deliver artifacts: milestone schema JSON (ops), runbook template (Confluence link), dashboard queries (Datadog/Grafana hints), GitHub PR template for cutover.

Acceptance criteria:
- A documented milestone schema that includes: name, owner, start window, soft-gates (informational), hard-gates (block cutover), rollback triggers, evidence artifact links.
- Runbook template filled with an example SOC2 cutover scenario and validated with Security team sign-off.
- Mapping of each risk signal to a concrete metric/alert and associated threshold.
- Dashboards and alert rules created in staging and validated in one canary cutover.
- Automation hooks (webhook or workflow) defined for at least 3 hard-gates (e.g., failing auth smoke tests, KV cache mismatch, audit-log backfill lag > 6h).

Non-goals:
- Building the full automation engine (this ticket provides schema and example integrations; engineering tickets will implement the checks).
- Completing all cutovers — only runbook and two validated canaries (SOC2 evidence switch + SSO test-idp) are required for this ticket.
